chunks: And through his chain of narration, he said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Ali’s hand is the same as my hand.

key_terms.صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ: Peace be upon him and his family

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet mean when he says Ali's hand is like his own?
ai.summary: This concise hadith from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* utilizes the metaphor of 'covering' or 'equivalence' to affirm Ali ibn Abi Talib’s unique authority as the Prophet’s representative. In Shia exegesis, this phrase underscores the concept of *Nass* (designation) and the inseparable link between the Prophet’s leadership and Ali’s, serving as a foundational proof for his succession.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-305 According to the same documentation,the Prophet (S) said, “
Ali’s hand is the same as my hand.”
